events.title: Lol Tolhurst at Recovery and Resilience Festival
events.summary: The Cure co-founder Lol Tolhurst will speak about recovery and managing substance use disorder at the Recovery and Resilience Festival in Wyandotte. The event focuses on recovery, wellness, and community, with free admission and tickets available online.
events.imageAlt: Lol Tolhurst, former drummer of The Cure, speaking at an event.

events.title: The Recovery and Resilience Festival
events.summary: The Recovery and Resilience Festival is a music and art festival in Wyandotte focusing on recovery from drugs and alcohol. Festival goers can expect free activities such as creative writing workshops and more.

events.title: Eastern Market After Dark
events.summary: The Eastern Market lights up at night to host artisan vendors, demonstrations and more as a part of Detroit Month of Design. Nearby, the Detroit Riverfront Conservancy hosts an activation on the Dequindre Cut, shops and restaurants extend their hours, and Slow Roll hosts an evening bike ride.

events.title: Astronomy on the Beach
events.summary: Great Lakes Association of Astronomy Clubs marks 30 years of Astronomy on the Beach. This year’s theme is Artemis II – returning to the moon in honor of the recent space exploration mission. In addition to peering at the expanse of space, guests can listen to keynote speakers, demonstrations and presentations, and enter a mini telescope raffle. Both nights end with a laser tour of the night sky.

events.title: Frankenfest
events.summary: A monstrous mashup of art and the paranormal takes over historic Fort Wayne. Expect electrifying entertainment (including aerial shows every hour), over a hundred artists on site, and the chance to explore the fort. Indoors, Michigan based podcasts give presentations on local hauntings and the macabre. Note that some featured artwork is unsuitable for children.

events.title: Folk Festival
events.summary: The Michigan Folk School welcomes all to a free showcase of folksy-skills, from gardening to blacksmithing to handweaving and more. Food and beverages are available for sale on site, and guests can listen to live music at two stages; one will be hosting a vintage string band, and the other features vocalist Kandy Fredrick and Irish Band Lochanna Mora. There’s also a silent auction of artisan goods.

events.title: Recovery and Resilience Music Festival
events.summary: This family friendly, sober event brings together artists, advocates and recovery organizations for a day of community. Attendees can enjoy food, coffee, creative workshops, resource meetings and live music. Plus, Lol Tolhurst from The Cure gives a keynote address.

events.title: Adult Spelling Bee Fundraiser
events.summary: Hosted by Stephen Henderson and Maxie Jones, the 8th Annual Spelling Bee Fundraiser raises funds for the Dominican Literacy Center’s teaching and community outreach needs. Along with the spelling contest, guests can expect good music with DJ La’Roc, food and drink, and good vibes.

events.title: Pandit Partha Bose + Pandit Samar Saha
events.summary: Pandit Partha Bose, a master Sitarist of the Maihar Gharana, and Pandit Samar Saha, a virtuoso Tabla player, present a fusion of Hindustani classical music and jazz. Their performance showcases intricate improvisation, rhythmic complexity, and a deep spiritual resonance rooted in centuries-old traditions.
events.imageAlt: Pandit Partha Bose + Pandit Samar Saha

events.title: Royal Oak Restaurant Week
events.summary: Royal Oak diners will have an excuse to restaurant-hop next week as the city’s annual Restaurant Week returns with discounted three-course meals at more than 20 downtown spots. The event runs Sunday, Sept. 20, through Sunday, Sept. 27, with prix fixe meals starting at $20 per person.
events.imageAlt: Royal Oak Restaurant Week event image

events.title: Recovery & Resilience Festival: A Celebration of Recovery Pathways
events.summary: The first Recovery & Resilience Festival brings together music, art, and support for recovery, featuring guest speaker Lol Tolhurst of The Cure, workshops, and Detroit-area musicians. The event highlights community programs and recovery pathways.

events.title: Festa di San Gennaro
events.summary: An Italian street festival at San Morello featuring made-to-order street food, cocktails, beer, wine, nonalcoholic drinks, music, and entertainment.

events.title: DARKË Tasting Series
events.summary: An intimate five-course dinner at BESA Detroit featuring seasonal ingredients, local purveyors, and globally inspired flavors.

events.title: Endless Summer Rum Event
events.summary: A free rum seminar and cocktail event at The Skip featuring tropical classics like mojitos, piña coladas, and painkillers.

events.title: Mare e Monti Five-Course Dinner
events.summary: A five-course Italian dinner at Adelina pairing flavors from the sea and mountains, accompanied by five Italian wines.

events.title: Jesus is Lord women’s Conference
events.summary: A one-day women’s gathering in Ann Arbor providing a safe space to explore faith, with live worship, relatable messages, and honest conversations. Open to women seeking growth, healing, or community in their faith journey.
events.registration: Sign up by August 30th for an extra prize. Message or register at https://subspla.sh/67bjx2w

events.title: Annual Ann Arbor Russian Festival: St. Vladimir Russian Orthodox Church
events.summary: Slavic food and drinks, including blini, borscht, and more. Live entertainment by bell ringers, St. Vladimir’s Choir, traditional dancers, and others. Also, a tearoom with Russian sweets, church tours, and a kids corner with a bounce house, petting zoo, games, and more.

events.title: Country Fair: Wiard’s Orchards
events.summary: A carnival atmosphere with family-oriented fall activities including wagon rides, a petting farm, corn maze, and more. Special events include a food truck rally on Sept. 12–13 and a Fall Car & Jeep Show on Sept. 19–20. Additional paid activities available on weekends.

events.title: Blast Corn Maze: Nixon Farms
events.summary: A large corn maze with 3.5 miles of trails and 3 exits for varying route lengths. Features include a U-Pick pumpkin patch, hayrides, petting zoo, pedal cars, straw maze, and yard games. On Sept. 27, Family Fun Day (11 a.m.–3 p.m.) offers ice cream, balloon art, kids' activities, and live music from the Saline Fiddlers.
events.price: $16 (ages 5–12, $13; age 4 & under, free with adult admission)

events.title: David Janeway Trio ft. Ali Jackson & Rodney Whitaker
events.summary: The David Janeway Trio, featuring Ali Jackson and Rodney Whitaker, performs two sets at 7pm and 8:30pm with a $25 cover charge.
events.imageAlt: David Janeway Trio ft. Ali Jackson & Rodney Whitaker

events.title: Flowers of Vietnam hosts immersive dinners blending food, art and music
events.summary: Dinner is getting the full sensory treatment this month at Flowers of Vietnam, where a new culinary series called Pinpoint pairs food with art, music, scent, and design. The residency, part of Detroit Month of Design, features Detroit chefs in experiences built around their food, culture, and personal memories, including custom art installations, photography, curated music, scent design, and keepsakes.
events.registration: Admission is free with an RSVP, while food, drinks, and additional experiences are available for purchase.
events.imageAlt: Flowers of Vietnam hosts immersive dinners blending food, art and music

events.title: Nate Topo Group
events.summary: Nate Topo Group, a Detroit-based jazz ensemble featuring saxophonist, pianist, and vocalist Nate Topo, will perform two sets at 7pm and 8:30pm. Known for blending vintage jazz tones with modern creativity, the group interprets standards and originals with a Motown influence.

events.title: AADL Celebrates Dolly Parton with Free Community-Wide Dolly Day
events.summary: The Ann Arbor District Library (AADL) is inviting the community to celebrate one of America’s most beloved entertainers with a day devoted to music, movies, crafts and the enduring spirit of Dolly Parton.

events.title: Windsor International Film Festival Screening
events.summary: Film lovers can enjoy a free outdoor screening of the comedy Best in Show at Campus Martius Park on September 25, celebrating storytelling and cross-border connections between Detroit and Windsor.

events.title: Russ Macklem Detroit Quintet
events.summary: Russ Macklem Detroit Quintet performs at Blue LLaMA Jazz Club. The quintet, featuring Kasan Belgrave, makes their debut at the 2024 Detroit Jazz Festival and includes sets at 7pm and 9pm with a $25 cover charge.

events.title: Women in Jazz Showcase
events.summary: An elegant evening celebrating the powerhouse women of jazz featuring Pamela Wise, Lady Vonne, and Naima Shambourger with two exceptional vocal sets at 6:00 PM and 7:30 PM.

events.title: Ypsilanti Grub Crawl Ypsitasty Coming Soon
events.summary: Ypsitasty celebrates its 15th year on Tuesday, Sept. 29, from 4 to 8 p.m. The popular grub crawl takes place in Downtown Ypsilanti, Cross Street and Depot Town, with local restaurants offering tasty bites and other businesses staying open late to invite attendees to stop in.
events.venue: Downtown Ypsilanti, Cross Street, and Depot Town

events.title: Date Night: Jacob Hart Piano Duo
events.summary: Join Jacob Hart Piano Duo for a date night at Blue LLama on September 30 with two sets at 7pm and 8pm. Enjoy a free cover, full dinner menu, and a special $95 Dinner for Two with your choice of 1 appetizer, 2 entrees, and 1 dessert to share.
events.imageAlt: Date Night: Jacob Hart Piano Duo

events.title: Ellen Rowe Trio ft. Rob Bickley & Pete Siers
events.summary: Ellen Rowe Trio featuring Rob Bickley & Pete Siers performs two sets at 7pm and 8:30pm with a $25 cover charge. Ellen Rowe is a jazz pianist and composer currently teaching at the University of Michigan.
events.imageAlt: Ellen Rowe Trio ft. Rob Bickley & Pete Siers

events.title: Erena Terakubo Quartet
events.summary: Internationally acclaimed saxophonist and flutist Erena Terakubo performs with her quartet. Known for her expressive artistry and technical mastery, she has performed with leading jazz artists and launched her career with a debut album that topped Japanese jazz charts.

events.title: WEMU 5:01 Jazz Series: Sean Dobbins Trio’s Tribute to Stevie Wonder
events.summary: Sean Dobbins, a renowned Detroit jazz musician, pays tribute to Stevie Wonder with his trio. Known for his hard-driving rhythm and melodic sensibility, Dobbins has collaborated with jazz legends and earned prestigious awards like the Woody Herman Jazz Award and Louis Armstrong Scholarship.
events.imageAlt: WEMU 5:01 Jazz Series: Sean Dobbins Trio’s Tribute to Stevie Wonder

events.title: Campus Kids Day: Lil’ Boo Bash
events.summary: Campus Kids Day: Lil’ Boo Bash features Halloween-themed activities including a costume contest, crafts, giveaways, lawn games, and a giant pumpkin bounce house at Campus Martius Park. Presented by Corewell Health and supported by the Detroit Zoo.
events.registration: Not required, but registration is encouraged to help businesses prepare

events.title: Downtown Detroit Treat n’ Peek
events.summary: Downtown Detroit Treat n’ Peek is a trick-or-treat adventure along Woodward Avenue featuring dozens of participating businesses. Attendees can collect treats and explore downtown shops, restaurants, and businesses.
events.venue: Cadillac Square and along Woodward Avenue
events.registration: Not required, but registration is encouraged to help businesses prepare

events.title: Bridge Michigan’s Issues Summit
events.summary: Join Bridge on Oct. 21 for our free, half-day Issues Summit on the Marygrove campus in Detroit and streamed virtually

events.title: After Dark: Weird Science
events.summary: After Dark: Weird Science is an adults-only night featuring unexpected experiments, curious discoveries, and the science of fear. Attendees can explore with Wayne State University neurology students, hear from mortuary science professors, and experience the eerie side of the cosmos in the Penske Planetarium.

events.title: Big Sky Company: A Benefit for the ACLU
events.summary: Big Sky Company is a collective featuring Mike Ward, Dave Boutette, Annie Bacon, Kristi Davis, and others, performing their own songs and debuting a new project. Proceeds from the event will benefit the ACLU.
events.imageAlt: Big Sky Company performance at North Star Lounge

events.title: Happy Hour: Andy Baker
events.summary: Join us for a free happy hour concert! Michigan singer/songwriter Andy Baker has spent 3 decades captivating audiences with his unique style of soul satisfying folk. His recent accolades include winning the 2020 Kerrville Newfolk Songwriting Competition and the 2022 Great River Folk Festival Songwriting Competition, as well as being featured as an Emerging Artist at the 2020 Falcon Ridge Folk Festival.

events.title: Lions Day at the Detroit Zoo
events.summary: The Detroit Zoo partners with the Detroit Lions for Lions Day, featuring appearances by Roary, the Detroit Lions Cheerleaders, the Honolulu Boom Drumline, a meet-and-greet with a Lions legend, lions-themed education stations, zookeeper chats, a family Zoo membership giveaway, and a raffle for signed Lions memorabilia. Guests wearing Lions gear receive 10% off select retail items.
events.imageAlt: Lions Day at the Detroit Zoo featuring lion cubs and football-themed activities

events.title: Cartoons and Stereo Vol 2.
events.summary: The free festival will feature multiple local and national musical acts such as Curtis Roach, Liv. E and Kareem Riggins of GENA, Mavi, The Cool Kids, Stoop Lee and more, alongside a skateboarding competition. The goal is to celebrate the intersections of music, fashion, art, skating and food.
events.imageAlt: Stoop Lee, hip hop artist from Detroit

Head to Cadillac Square weekdays from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. to enjoy a rotating lineup of food trucks and carts serving returning favorites and new culinary finds.

events.summary: Michigan’s largest weekly food truck rally returns for its 14th season in Downtown Detroit. Visit Cadillac Square weekdays from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. to sample a rotating lineup of food trucks and carts offering local flavors.

events.summary: An annual presentation featuring Detroit’s jazz masters, emerging talent, vintage performance screenings, and an exhibition of Coltrane’s discography and memorabilia. Join NKSK Events for the Centennial Concert Experience.

events.summary: Downtown Street Eats is Michigan’s largest weekly food truck rally, returning for its 14th season in Downtown Detroit. It features a rotating lineup of food trucks and carts serving local flavors, open weekdays from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. in Cadillac Square.

events.title: Northville Victorian Festival
events.summary: From Sept. 18 through Sept. 20, historic downtown Northville will become the center of a three-day celebration of the town’s history, community and Victorian heritage. The festival includes a Victorian parade, historic building exploration, and vintage activities.

events.summary: The Detroit Lions will face the New York Jets in an NFL game at Ford Field.

events.title: Dearborn + Detroit Community Block Party
events.summary: The annual block party will feature free food, music, games, and community resources.

events.title: Citizen Detroit DPSCD Meet Your Candidates
events.summary: Citizen Detroit is hosting a Meet Your Candidates event for the Detroit Public School Community District School Board. Over 30 candidates will participate in a speed-dating dinner and dialogue event for 5 open seats. The event will take place at IBEW Local 58 on 1358 Abbot Street in Detroit from 5-8:30 p.m. Admission is free, but registration is required via Eventbrite by Sept. 28.
events.imageAlt: Citizen Detroit DPSCD Meet Your Candidates event

events.title: Detroit After-School Program Expansion
events.summary: The City of Detroit will spend over $2 million to expand after-school programs through the nonprofit Get On and Learn (GOAL Line), adding programs at four recreation centers and three library branches for all public, charter, and home school students. The initiative aims to provide sports, tutoring, transportation, and ensure access within a 2-mile radius of every school.

events.title: Community Emergency Response Team Volunteer Training
events.summary: Detroit residents can learn emergency response and disaster preparedness skills through free training hosted by the city. The training includes defibrillator use, injury care, and life-saving techniques. Sessions run September 17-19 and 26, 2026, at Detroit Emergency Management and Homeland Security.
events.venue: Detroit Emergency Management and Homeland Security
